risk_note: RV2 by path. During a union failure the hot list and the home feed answer an old page only while its age is at most pool.max_age_sec (default 7200 s, D10-508, BR-PRICE-11 as written back by couli #240, stated in the brief because SPEC_REF does not hold it yet). Past the limit the failure propagates as if no entry existed: hot list 50304 without reason, feed drops the channel. Categories carry no price and keep their behaviour; physical retention is unchanged. Reading feed.fallback_pool_id belongs to B1-05r. No money moves: display quotes only, and the open re-checks the price. Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
